findings.issue: Raw with an inline eslint-disable for @next/next/no-img-element, repeated in the pokemon page; no comment recording why next/image (with a runtime loader derived from API_BASE_URL) was rejected.
findings.suggestion: Either add a loader-based next/image setup or a one-line comment at each disable explaining the runtime-host rationale, so the decision survives review.

findings.issue: Hand-rolled TTL/promise cache duplicates a concern the framework now owns ('use cache' + cacheLife under cacheComponents, or unstable_cache under the default model); justified by the spec, but a future Next upgrade touches this file.
findings.suggestion: Keep it, but note in the comment that it is the seam to replace with 'use cache' when cacheComponents is adopted.

findings.issue: Back/forward navigation while a search debounce is pending can leave the input text desynced from the URL query (sentQuery guard covers the common paths, not this one).
findings.suggestion: On popstate-derived prop changes, always adopt the URL's q (or flush/cancel the pending debounce on navigation).

findings.issue: Invalid type/generation query values are silently dropped: the URL keeps ?type=xyz while the select shows 'All types'.
findings.suggestion: Either redirect to the canonical URL (param stripped) or treat unknown values as a 404, so URL and UI can't disagree.

findings.issue: getMoves fires Promise.all over every move detail for the selected game with no concurrency cap (~100+ simultaneous fetches on a cold cache).
findings.suggestion: Fine against a local API with the 60s cache, but a small p-limit-style chunking helper would make it safe against any upstream.

findings.issue: Four resource pages repeat the same getX/generateMetadata/notFound scaffold (moves, abilities, types/[name], pokemon).
findings.suggestion: Extract a tiny withResource(resource, name) helper or a shared fetchResource(name, path) so a change to the 404/metadata policy lands in one place.

findings.issue: slug()'s regex contains literal combining diacritic characters (U+0300–U+036F written invisibly in source), which is unreadable and fragile in diffs.
findings.suggestion: Write the range explicitly (/[\u0300-\u036f]/g) or use /\p{M}/u; or drop slug() entirely since titles are fixed English strings.

findings.issue: prefetch={false} is repeated at 8 link sites rather than being a single documented decision.
findings.suggestion: Decide once: either rely on Next 16's default dynamic-route prefetch (loading.js only) or add a comment explaining the blanket opt-out.
Import MISSING from '@/lib/format' (the module is deliberately client-safe).

summary: A clean, idiomatic Next.js 16 App Router app: RSC data loading, URL-as-state filters, proper 404/error handling and a well-bounded data layer with an in-flight-promise cache. The only recurring nits are framework escape hatches applied without documentation (raw , blanket prefetch={false}, hand-rolled TTL cache) and a mild scaffold duplication across the four resource pages. I'd approve after one round of comment-and-nit changes.
